source_visual_observations: Triangle ABC, A above B-left and C-right; D on AB and E on AC; segment DE. Source angle A=80°, B=60°.
audit.independent_solution: Triangle ABC has angle C = 180 - 80 - 60 = 40 degrees. Since DE is parallel to BC and EC is opposite EA, angle CED is supplementary to angle ACB: 180 - 40 = 140 degrees, choice D.
